top_violation_types.title: Other Programs Must Not Use Licensed Indoor Space (26 TAC §744.2909)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation still has not provided a shared plan for two programs that share space at the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §744.901(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The program director's staff file did not have a copy of their photo I.D.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Emergency preparedness plan was unavailable to review

top_violation_types.title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced.

top_violation_types.title: Handwashing Sinks and Toilets (26 TAC §747.4201)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the toilet available for use to the children was not able to flush properly.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The immunization record for one child was not up to date.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 12 children did not have a health statement on file.
